name: notion
description: Notion, read only: search the pages shared with an integration and read a page as text. Needs an internal integration token.

tools.name: notion_check_connection
tools.description: Check the Notion connection (integration token) and show which workspace it belongs to.

tools.name: notion_search
tools.description: Search the pages and databases that were shared with the integration. Returns id, type, title, link and last edit, newest first (read only).

tools.name: notion_get_page
tools.description: Read one page as plain text (headings, paragraphs, lists, to-dos, quotes; the first 400 blocks). Read only.

notion_api_token.title: Integration token
notion_api_token.description: notion.so/profile/integrations, New integration (internal), copy the secret. Then share each page with it: page menu, Connections. The integration sees only what is shared. Stored as a secret.
